info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Market Operation By Param1-spec
info.description: The Market Operation Retrieval API allows consumers to access specific market operation data based on a unique parameter. This endpoint is typically used in the financial sector to retrieve detailed information about mutual fund administration operations, facilitating better decision-making and strategy formulation. Key users include financial analysts, portfolio managers, and banking systems looking to integrate market data effectively. The API provides essential insights into market activities, ensuring users have access to timely and relevant financial information.

get.summary: Retrieve mutual fund administration details by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific mutual fund administration using its unique identifier. It helps in managing and tracking mutual fund operations efficiently.
